name: Yateet Agrawal
heroSub: I’m Yateet Agrawal, a backend-focused full-stack engineer. React and TypeScript on the front, C# and .NET behind it. Here is every turn of the race, laid out to read.

stations.title: About me
stations.body: I’m Yateet Agrawal, a backend-focused full-stack engineer in Noida, India. I build enterprise applications with C#/.NET, React and TypeScript, SQL and REST APIs, and more recently agentic AI and MCP servers.

stations.title: Experience
stations.body: Where I’ve worked and studied, most recent first.

roles.text: Delivered a full-stack SOW Management Portal (10+ React pages, 20+ .NET APIs, SQL stored procedures, RBAC, Playwright tests) and architected an MCP server for ServiceNow agentic AI.
Built the Field Forecast Tool and enhanced Predictive Staffing on the PepsiCo UGM Dashboard, and shipped two production Power BI dashboards on Microsoft sales metrics.
CGPA 8.3. Published a paper on decentralized identity management using blockchain at ICDAM 2025, a Scopus-indexed conference.

stations.title: Frontend
stations.sub: The cockpit: everything the driver touches
stations.body: I build React and TypeScript interfaces for enterprise apps: 10+ production pages on the SOW Management Portal, several UI redesigns, and automated Playwright test suites.

stations.title: Backend
stations.sub: The engine: the power behind the interface
stations.body: I design REST APIs in C# and .NET, write SQL stored procedures, and build role-based access control. Most recently: an MCP server in Python with Entra ID auth, Kong gateway routing and natural-language-to-DAX translation.

stations.title: Projects
stations.body: One from work and two of my own.

projects.name: Agentic AI MCP Server
projects.text: An MCP server that lets ServiceNow agentic AI create Power BI reports on its own: Entra ID auth, Kong gateway routing, NLQ-to-DAX translation and a visual generation pipeline. Built at MAQ Software.

projects.name: Offline Document Sharing Tool
projects.text: Cross-platform P2P file transfer over WiFi using QR codes. Supports iOS↔Windows and Android↔Mac transfers, with an adaptive UI and real-time status tracking. In active development.

projects.name: Blockchain-Based Web App
projects.text: A decentralized identity management system for banking KYC, using Ethereum smart contracts, IPFS storage and role-based access control.
